+def validate_completion(parts, *, kind, phase, commit, binding_sha, command):
+    """Check pinned external observer evidence; this does not authenticate itself."""
+    s.require(s.keys(parts,COMPLETION_PARTS) and all(type(v) is bytes for v in parts.values()),
+              'COMPLETION_PARTS_INVALID')
+    item=s.strict_json(parts['execution'],canonical_required=True)
+    final=s.strict_json(parts['final'],canonical_required=True)
+    s.require(s.keys(item,OUTER_KEYS) and item['schema']=='lupine.li.complete-readiness.outer-execution.v1'
+        and item['kind']==kind and item['phase']==phase and item['commit']==commit
+        and item['binding_sha256']==binding_sha and s.canonical(item['command'])==s.canonical(command),
+        'OUTER_IDENTITY_INVALID')
+    s.require(type(item['exit_code']) is int and item['exit_code']==0
+        and all(item[k] is False for k in ('timed_out','launch_failed','output_limit'))
+        and all(item[k] is True for k in ('process_completed','process_group_cleanup','source_and_tools_verified'))
+        and type(item['started_ns']) is int and type(item['finished_ns']) is int
+        and 0 < item['started_ns'] <= item['finished_ns']
+        and s.hexhash(item['before_state_sha256'])
+        and item['before_state_sha256']==item['after_state_sha256'], 'OUTER_NOT_COMPLETED')
+    for stream in ('stdout','stderr'):
+        s.require(type(item[stream+'_bytes']) is int and item[stream+'_bytes']==len(parts[stream])
+            and item[stream+'_sha256']==s.sha(parts[stream]), 'OUTER_LOG_MISMATCH')
+    s.require(parts['stderr']==b'' and parts['stdout']==parts['final'], 'OUTER_FINAL_MISMATCH')
+    if kind=='package':
+        wanted={'status':'COMPLETE_PACKAGE_AND_STRICT','commit':commit,
+                'scientific_admission':False,'no_retry':True}
+        s.require(s.canonical(final)==s.canonical(wanted),'OUTER_PACKAGE_FINAL_INVALID')
+    else:
+        s.require(s.keys(final,{'status','phase','commit','binding_sha256','public_sha256',
+                  'route_review_sha256','scientific_admission','automatic_advance','no_retry'})
+            and final['status']=='COMPLETE_IDENTICAL_PHASE_PAIR' and final['phase']==phase
+            and final['commit']==commit and final['binding_sha256']==binding_sha
+            and s.hexhash(final['public_sha256']) and s.hexhash(final['route_review_sha256'])
+            and final['scientific_admission'] is False and final['automatic_advance'] is False
+            and final['no_retry'] is True,'OUTER_PHASE_FINAL_INVALID')
+    return final
+
